appointment_operation_receipts_check1.name: appointment_operation_receipts_check1
appointment_operation_receipts_check1.value:
(state = 'cancelled' AND fingerprint IS NULL AND result IS NULL)
      OR (state IN ('completed','failed') AND fingerprint IS NOT NULL AND result IS NOT NULL)

appointments_check.name: appointments_check
appointments_check.value: end_ms > start_ms AND end_ms::numeric = start_ms::numeric + duration_minutes::numeric * 60000

auth_identities_check.name: auth_identities_check
auth_identities_check.value: (role = 'platform_admin' AND business_id IS NULL) OR (role = 'business_user' AND business_id IS NOT NULL)

business_calendar_closures_check.name: business_calendar_closures_check
business_calendar_closures_check.value:
(kind = 'date' AND closed_date IS NOT NULL
      AND closed_date BETWEEN DATE '0001-01-01' AND DATE '9999-12-31'
      AND start_raw IS NULL AND end_raw IS NULL AND start_ms IS NULL AND end_ms IS NULL)
    OR (kind = 'interval' AND closed_date IS NULL
      AND start_raw IS NOT NULL AND end_raw IS NOT NULL
      AND start_ms IS NOT NULL AND end_ms IS NOT NULL AND end_ms > start_ms
      AND start_ms BETWEEN -62135683140000 AND 253402387139999
      AND end_ms BETWEEN -62135683140000 AND 253402387139999)

tenant_records_business_user.name: tenant_records_business_user
tenant_records_business_user.using:
current_setting('app.actor_role', true) = 'business_user'
    AND business_id = nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '')::uuid
tenant_records_business_user.withCheck:
current_setting('app.actor_role', true) = 'business_user'
    AND business_id = nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '')::uuid

whatsapp_agenda_receipts_silent_output_c.name: whatsapp_agenda_receipts_silent_output_check
whatsapp_agenda_receipts_silent_output_c.value: (operation = 'silent' AND outbound_id IS NULL) OR (operation <> 'silent' AND outbound_id IS NOT NULL)

public.admin_business_status.definition:
SELECT b.id,b.name,b.status,b.created_at,b.last_technical_activity_at,
  CASE WHEN a.active THEN 'active' ELSE 'inactive' END agent_status,
  coalesce(lower(w.state),'link_required') whatsapp_status
  FROM businesses b LEFT JOIN agent_configs a ON a.business_id=b.id
  LEFT JOIN whatsapp_connections w ON w.business_id=b.id WHERE b.deleted_at IS NULL
public.admin_business_status.name: admin_business_status
